definitions.explanation: A word formed by combining two or more kanji characters.
A fixed expression or phrase with a specific meaning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{漢字|かんじ}→漢字：09480_kanji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{熟語|じゅくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Memorizing kanji compound words is difficult.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧{熟語|じゅくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{教|おし}えて→教える：00526_oshieru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please tell me the meaning of this compound word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二字|にじ}→二字：noentry⟧{熟語|じゅくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}りなさい→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: Make a sentence using a two-character compound word.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四字|よじ}→四字：noentry⟧{熟語|じゅくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦テスト→テスト：01065_tesuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a test on four-character idioms.

examples.japanese: ⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{四字|よじ}→四字：noentry⟧{熟語|じゅくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{印象|いんしょう}→印象：01846_inshou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{残|のこ}り→残る：01187_nokoru⟧⟦やすい→〜やすい：18367_yasui⟧。
examples.english: Including four-character idioms in a speech makes it more memorable.

examples.japanese: 「⟦{一石二鳥|いっせきにちょう}→一石二鳥：04764_issekinichou⟧」⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦{使|つか}われる→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{四字|よじ}→四字：noentry⟧{熟語|じゅくご}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: 'Killing two birds with one stone' is a four-character idiom commonly used in Japanese too.

notes:
TYPES:
- ⟦{二字|にじ}→二字：noentry⟧{熟語|じゅくご} (two-character compounds, e.g., ⟦{勉強|べんきょう}→勉強：00770_benkyou⟧)
- ⟦{四字|よじ}→四字：noentry⟧{熟語|じゅくご} (four-character idioms, e.g., ⟦{一石二鳥|いっせきにちょう}→一石二鳥：04764_issekinichou⟧)

⟦{四字|よじ}→四字：noentry⟧{熟語|じゅくご} are particularly important in Japanese:
- Often derived from classical Chinese
- Used to express complex ideas concisely
- Commonly tested in schools

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {熟語|じゅくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{覚|おぼ}える→覚える：00739_oboeru⟧ (to memorize compound words)
- {熟語|じゅくご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧ (meaning of a compound)
- {熟語|じゅくご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧ (to form compound words)
